films.title: H⁺ gradient se ATP kaise banta hai?

story: Thylakoid membrane par open karo; lumen accumulation ko mitochondrial intermembrane-space comparison se distinguish karo.
Teacher invitation mein electron transport ko ab proton accounting ke nazariye se dekho, electron route dobara explain nahi.
Three contributions track karo: lumen-side water splitting, stromal H⁺ uptake/lumen release by H carrier, aur stromal NADP reduction mein H⁺ consumption.
Figure 11.7 mein PQ/PQH₂, cytochrome B6f, PC, P700, Fd aur FNR labels locate karo; electron aur proton arrows alag colours mein follow karo.
Lumen high H⁺/low pH aur stroma lower H⁺ se electrochemical gradient banao.
'Gradient mein interest kyun?' pose karke answer do: controlled dissipation ATP synthesis ko energy deta hai.
CF₀ membrane proton channel aur stromal CF₁ head locate karo; lumen → stroma facilitated proton diffusion se conformational change aur ATP formation jodo.
Membrane, proton pump, gradient aur ATP synthase ki four requirements check karo; gradient breakdown H⁺ destruction nahi.
ATP aur NADPH ko stromal CO₂ fixation/sugar biosynthesis ki supply ke roop mein hand off karo.

analogy.picture: Dam ke peeche water level difference aur turbine se controlled return.
analogy.why_it_fits: Gradient build karne mein energy lagti hai; directed return usable work karata hai.

real_world: Compartment orientation predicts where protons accumulate and where ATP is made.

outside_book.what: Electrochemical gradients combine concentration and charge differences; pH falls as H⁺ rises.
outside_book.why: Makes the membrane mechanism and pH direction intelligible without invented pH values.

saman.shows: Faithful Figure 11.7 with every label, separate electron/proton arrows and the three gradient-building contributions.
saman.why: Integrates proton bookkeeping with actual compartment orientation.

films.title: ATP aur NADPH ka stromal destination

story: Stroma mein products ke destinations distinguish karo: O₂ diffuses out; ATP/NADPH biosynthesis ko support karte hain.
Light-on/off/on demonstration predict karao: available supplies se brief continuation, depletion par stop, light return par restart.
Misnomer question pose karke discuss karo: dark reaction ko night-only kehna galat hai.
Overall (CH₂O)ₙ se first-product question par aao; pathway ka first intermediate final sugar nahi.

saman.shows: Labelled algal CO₂ entering three-carbon PGA, alongside a PGA/3C versus OAA/4C classification.
saman.why: Separates tracing method, product identity and plant classification.

films.title: C₃ product ka acceptor C₂ kyun nahi?
films.question: CO₂ ka primary acceptor RuBP five-carbon kaise nikla?

story: In-text guess explicitly lo aur scientists ki same wrong assumption ka short story moment batao.

Five carbon aur two separate phosphate tags identify karo; acceptor aur product ko alag labels do.
5 + 1 = 3 + 3 counters se resolve karo: ek PGA nahi, two PGA molecules ka carbon account chahiye.

analogy.picture: Six beads ko two three-bead groups mein baantna.
analogy.why_it_fits: Products ki multiplicity acceptor ka correct carbon count samjhati hai.

real_world: An apparently obvious numerical guess can mislead an experimental search.

films.title: Calvin cycle: carbon aur energy ka hisaab
films.question: Calvin cycle sugar banate hue RuBP kaise regenerate karta hai aur kitni energy leta hai?

Book ka probable explanation do: extra ATP requirement meet karne mein cyclic phosphorylation help kar sakti hai, fixed universal coupling ratio mat claim karo.
In-text numerical question answer karo aur teacher ke input–output invitation ko three-row table task banao: 6CO₂/one glucose, 18ATP/18ADP, 12NADPH/12NADP.

analogy.why_it_fits: Initial capture aur local CO₂ release alag sites par hote hain.
